mechanism: Both agents are commonly used together for anaerobic bacterial infections with additive gastrointestinal effects and potential for altered microbiome; metronidazole may inhibit metabolism of amoxicillin through hepatic mechanisms.
action: Monitor for increased gastrointestinal adverse effects (nausea, diarrhea, metallic taste); combination is generally acceptable but counsel on side effects and take amoxicillin with food if tolerated.
